title: coelogyne alba
intro: Coelogyne alba, commonly known as the White Coelogyne, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is a type of epiphyte, which grows on other plants or objects for support, and is native to the tropical forests of Asia. The health benefits of Coelogyne alba include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its flavonoid and phenolic content. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolics, and alkaloids, which are believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
